properties.label: Relief wave under spare type
properties.text: Build a large architectural wave from repeated colored relief elements beneath a spare editorial heading. Protect large clear negative space between type and sculpture and keep small expression controls at the bottom.

properties.label: Phased thick relief units
properties.text: Give every relief element thickness. Use repetition, phase, spacing and depth to create the identity rather than identical flat rectangles.

properties.label: Warm plaster and cobalt
properties.text: Use a warm plaster ground, cobalt type and alternating saturated material faces.

properties.label: Edge-lit dimensional relief
properties.text: Use believable edge light, reflected color and coherent contact shadows to preserve separation between the thick relief units.

properties.label: Relief expression control
properties.text: Quiet, Flowing and Sculptural presets plus a continuous expression slider adjust the collective relief.

properties.label: Slow collective rhythm
properties.text: Use slow motion to alter the relief rhythm while the heading remains fixed. Provide pause, reduced motion and complete preset posters.

properties.label: Whole and detail relief check
properties.text: Judge the full wave silhouette, then inspect individual bevels, material separation and shadow consistency.

properties.label: Collision-free extremes
properties.text: Test extreme expression values without collisions or loss of shape.
